author: John Eldridge
title: Man hospitalized after domestic-related shooting on Colley Avenue - NewsBreak
text:
By John Eldridge ,
3 hours ago NORFOLK, Va. (WAVY) — A man has been hospitalized after a domestic-related shooting on Colley Avenue near Spotswood Avenue Wednesday night, according to Norfolk Police.
Officials say that officers were dispatched around 8:10 p.m.
Upon arrival, units located a man with life-threatening injuries. He was transported to a local hospital.
The below picture was taken by our crew at the scene.
WAVY Photo WAVY Video The concentration of the investigation appears to be in front of No Frill Bar And Grill.
Police say that 30-year-old Skylar Brock is the lone suspect in this investigation.
Skylar Brock (Courtesy: Norfolk Police Department) Anyone with information on his whereabouts is asked to call 911.
10 On Your Side will continue to monitor the situation, and will provide any additional information once received.
Continue to check WAVY.com for updates .
